The user asks: "You are agent A. Choose exactly one task for yourself... Write a short handoff for your own fresh successor. Convey the completed allocation and convention, including your own and your colleague's task. Do not change task facts or include experiment-condition labels. Return ONLY JSON {"task":"the task you took in the completed round","note":"handoff of at most 2000 characters"}."

We have been given that the original round assignment is {"A":"T2","B":"T3"} and the outcome is given. The user is agent A, so they need to output JSON with "task":"T2" and a note describing the handoff.

Thus answer: {"task":"T2","note":"..."}.

The note should convey the completed allocation and convention, including your own and colleague's task. So note: "In the completed round, A took T2 and B took T3. The next round starts fresh with all tasks unclaimed. Continue using the same convention: each agent picks a task independently, then C and D pick two distinct unclaimed tasks minimizing combined cost, tie-breaking lexicographically. The goal remains to maximize distinct tasks and minimize total cost. ..."

Make sure note <=2000 characters. Provide JSON only.
